title: Draw an axis
summary: An axis draws ticks and labels for a scale.
introduction: An axis draws ticks and labels for a scale. Your task: Change the domain to [0,20].
learningObjectives: Explain the example for draw an axis

blocks.text: An axis draws ticks and labels for a scale. Place its group at the edge of the chart where that scale should be read.
Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

blocks.title: Draw an axis

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `scaleLinear` maps numeric input values from its domain into output positions in its range.
`axisBottom` draws ticks and labels from the supplied scale beneath its axis line.

blocks.text: A horizontal number axis appears near the bottom of the SVG.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The axis uses the same scale as the data marks. A different domain would make labels disagree with the chart.
